name: Sword Adept
effectText: When you attack with a weapon that has the Sword tag, the bonus momentum cost to use Swift Task to attack again is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Blade Master 1
effectText: If you miss an attack with a weapon with the Sword tag and take the Swift Task to attack again the same turn, you may add a bonus die to your pool on the second attack.

name: Blade Master 2
effectText: When you use Swift Task to make an attack with the Sword tag, lower the Difficulty on that attack's roll by -1.

name: Into the Fray 1
effectText: Once a round, when you successfully defend using a weapon with the Sword tag against a melee attack, you may use a reaction to move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Into the Fray 2
effectText: When you take the Sprint Major Action, you may also make an attack with a weapon with the Sword tag as part of this action, but only after you've finished your movement.

name: Parrying Master 1
effectText: You may perform two rerolls instead of one if you are wielding two items with the Parrying quality.

name: Parrying Master 2
effectText: While defending while wielding two weapons with the parrying quality, the complication range of your attacker is increased by 2.

name: Axe Adept
effectText: 1/turn, when wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you can reroll any number of damage dice in your pool without spending bonus momentum.

name: Big Swing 1
effectText: When you miss on an attack while wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you may reroll the attack against a different target within Reach.

name: Big Swing 2
effectText: If you choose to attack a target you successfully attacked with a weapon with the Axe tag in the previous round, you may reduce the Difficulty of that attack by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Crusher 1
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action to give your next attack with a weapon with the Axe tag the Knockdown damage effect.

name: Crusher 2
effectText: When you successfully knock an enemy Prone using a weapon with the Axe tag, you gain 1 bonus momentum.

name: Guarding Axe 1
effectText: When you take the Block Minor Action while wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you may also move up to half your speed.

name: Guarding Axe 2
effectText: When you take the Block Minor Action while wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you or the target gains an additional 2[CD] Temporary HP.

name: Spear Adept
effectText: 1/turn when you make an attack with a weapon with the Spear tag, you may add a bonus die to your roll.

name: Long Reach 1
effectText: When you make a successful melee attack with a weapon with the Spear tag against a target that is not adjacent to you, you gain 1 bonus momentum.

name: Long Reach 2
effectText: When wielding a weapon with the Extended Quality, you may spend a Minor Action to give all melee attacks made against you +1 Difficulty until the start of your next turn. This benefit is lost if you cannot see your attacker or are prone.

name: Precise Piercer 1
effectText: Gain the following Minor Action: Pierce - While wielding a weapon with the Spear tag with two hands or with one hand free, you may spend a Minor Action to give your next attack the Piercing quality.

name: Precise Piercer 2
effectText: You may roll an additional number of [CD] equal to the weapon's base damage rating on an attack benefiting from the Pierce Minor Action.

name: Hold the Line 1
effectText: Whenever a character enters or takes any movement inside your Reach, you may make an Opportunity Attack against them.

name: Hold the Line 2
effectText: As a Minor Action while wielding a weapon with the Spear tag, you prepare yourself for an onslaught of enemies. You may use the Opportunity Attack reaction once every turn until the start of your next turn.

name: Bow Adept
effectText: While also wielding a weapon with the Bow tag, when you take the Aim Minor Action and reroll a die, you may choose between results.

name: Sniper 1
effectText: At the start of your turn, you may use a free action to become Immobilized until the start of your next turn. While Immobilized, your attacks with weapons with the Bow tag gain +3 Range.

name: Sniper 2
effectText: While Immobilized, you gain an extra +3[CD] on ranged attacks with weapons with the Bow tag.

name: Close Range Shooter 1
effectText: You ignore the Difficulty increase when making a ranged attack with a weapon with the Bow tag within the target's Reach. If you would already have this benefit (e.g. wielding a bow with the Close Quarters quality), you gain 1 bonus momentum after a successful attack with a weapon with the Bow tag against a target if you are within their Reach.

name: Close Range Shooter 2
effectText: When you succeed on a defense against ranged and melee weapon attacks, you may counterstrike with a weapon with the Bow tag.

name: Bowmaster 1
effectText: When you make an attack with a weapon with the Bow tag benefiting from the Aim Minor Action, you may choose to give the attack the Pinning damage effect or the Burst 1 quality.

name: Bowmaster 2
effectText: If you miss an attack with a weapon with the Bow tag benefiting from the Aim Minor Action, you gain a bonus die on your next bow attack.

name: Gauntlet Adept
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action in order to grant your next attack with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag the Knockdown damage effect.

name: Duck and Weave 1
effectText: After making a successful attack with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag, you may move either one space directly back from your target, or you may move through their space to an adjacent tile, without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Duck and Weave 2
effectText: When you make an attack with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag, successful or not, you may move up to 2 spaces away from your target, or you may move through their space to an adjacent tile and then move 1 additional space, without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Mean Right Hook 1
effectText: Your attacks with weapons with the Gauntlets tag also gain Knockback 1.

name: Mean Right Hook 2
effectText: 1/scene, you may use your Major Action to perform a Mighty Blow with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag. Make an attack, as normal. On a success, you double the amount of damage dice granted from your weapon (not the damage dice from your Skirmish), and your target gains the Dazed condition until the end of their next turn.

name: Unarmed Fighter 1
effectText: You may use your bare fists to attack. Your unarmed attacks are 0[CD] Gauntlet weapons (they only deal [CD] equal to your Skirmish). When you succeed on an unarmed attack, you generate 1 bonus momentum.

name: Unarmed Fighter 2
effectText: You may make two unarmed attacks as part of the same attack action if both hands are free.

name: Cavalry Adept
effectText: You do not suffer the Difficulty Increase for Tasks taken while mounted in combat. If you are wielding a weapon with the Saddleback quality, you gain 1 bonus momentum after a successful mounted attack.

name: Mounted Combatant 1
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action to give your Saddleback weapon the Knockdown damage effect. If your weapon already has this damage effect, instead you reduce the number of [!] needed to knock your target prone by -1.

name: Mounted Combatant 2
effectText: When making an attack with a Saddleback weapon while mounted, you gain a bonus die.

name: Spur 1
effectText: Your mounted speed is increased by 3. This does not apply to flying mounts.

name: Spur 2
effectText: For every 3 tiles you move in a row before making a melee attack while mounted, the attack gains an extra 1[CD] damage, up to a maximum of 4[CD].

name: Flier 1
effectText: You are able to ride a flying mount, and may Recall your mount as a Minor Action instead of a Major one.

name: Flier 2
effectText: Whenever you successfully evade or counter an attack while on a flying mount, you gain 2 bonus momentum.

name: Rapier Adept
effectText: Before or after you make an attack with a Rapier, you may perform one additional Minor Action without needing to spend bonus momentum if your other hand is free or holding an Effortless item.

name: Weapon of Authority 1
effectText: When you make a successful attack with a Rapier, you may nominate a single ally within line of sight, who receives a bonus die on their next Task.

name: Weapon of Authority 2
effectText: After you use your Major Action to attempt a Task using Authority, the cost of using a Swift Task to attack with a Rapier is reduced by 1 bonus Momentum, to a minimum of 0.

name: Fencer 1
effectText: After making an attack with your Rapier, the bonus Momentum cost to perform a Swift Task to attack with it again is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Fencer 2
effectText: When wielding a Rapier in one hand and a Dagger in the other, you may apply the Effortless quality to the Dagger. In addition, when you successfully defend against an attack from an enemy while doing so, the Difficulty of your next attack against the attacker is reduced by 1.

name: Thrown Weapons Adept
effectText: When you make a successful attack with a weapon with the Thrown quality, you generate 1 bonus momentum.

name: Pinning Accuracy 1
effectText: Your attacks with weapons with the Thrown quality gain the Pinning damage effect.

name: Pinning Accuracy 2
effectText: If you Aim before making an attack with a weapon with the Thrown quality and the Pinning damage effect, the target is immobilized regardless of how many effects are rolled.

name: Create Some Distance 1
effectText: The range on your attack with weapons with the Thrown quality increases by 2. All weapons with the Thrown quality you wield gain an additional use before they are depleted.

name: Create Some Distance 2
effectText: When you take the Disengage Major Action, you may make an attack with a weapon with the Thrown quality as part of the same action. Weapons with the Thrown quality gain two further additional uses before they are depleted.
